answer: Divergent-Response Identity Test. Each identity must answer a hidden, per-epoch challenge whose correct output depends on private local state, then broadcast a signed pulse of its answer. Honest agents produce divergent replies; clones forced to share one source cannot diverge and collide. The island of unique answers per challenge is checked for duplicate clusters, and collisions nullify every matching identity. An attacker cloning N identities must run N independent state tracks plus a falcon-fast per-epoch response path,
